reasoning_evidence: IA is a 3-phase SHARED interconnection agreement: Generation Phase 1 = our INR 20INR0091 (168.64 MW), Phase 2 = sibling 25INR0672 (168.64 MW), Phase 3 = 26INR0524 (171.98 MW, now owned by Greenalia Solar Power Misae III LLC, NOT our SPV) — all three tie into one shared Fagus Substation per Exhibit C-1 one-line drawing

7th Amendment (executed 2026-03-12, filed 2026-03-17, ~1 month before this scan) is the CURRENT contractual schedule: Phase 1 (our INR) Scheduled COD = 85 months from Original Agreement execution (2019-02-21) = 2026-03-21

EIA-860M (independent 2nd source, name-matched plant 67123 'Fagus Solar Park', Excel Advantage Services LLC, verified via eia_history.py --write): status (OP) Operating from the 2026-04 monthly report, with actual operating date reported as 2025-12 - i.e. EIA says the plant was ALREADY physically operating 3 months before even the amended IA contractual COD (2026-03-21), and 5 months before the queue's own claim (2026-05-20)

Satellite imagery (2026-06-10 scene, 0.1% cloud) directly shows multiple large, COMPLETE, built-out solar arrays at the site coordinates - fully consistent with an already-operating plant, not a project still finishing construction

Greenalia's own PR (2025-03, financing-close article): construction was already 72% complete as of 2025-03-25 with 'expected COD Q3 2025' per the contemporaneous PRNewswire financing article - i.e. even a year before this scan, the developer's own public target was mid-2025, well ahead of both the queue claim and even the eventual IA contractual date

All independent evidence (EIA actual-ops date, satellite imagery, developer's own 72%-complete/Q3-2025-target financing announcement) agrees the plant is REAL, BUILT, and OPERATING - the queue's 2026-05-20 COD claim and even the IA's 2026-03-21 amended contractual COD both appear to be administrative/paperwork lag behind physical reality, not signs of a slipping or paper project

Independent COD estimate adopts EIA's reported actual operating date (2025-12) as the best evidence of when Phase 1 began commercial generation - the most authoritative independent (non-queue, non-developer-PR) data point available; drift risk vs the queue's 2026-05-20 claim is LOW in the sense that the plant is real and operating, though the exact queue-vs-EIA date mismatch (about 5 months) itself remains unexplained (possibly partial-phase energization, sync-approval vs commercial-approval distinction, or simple queue-field lag)
Financial security (Exhibit E) rose $18.0M (6th Amend) -> $19.5M (7th Amend) - continued active administration of the agreement as recently as March 2026, not an abandoned paper filing
